name: Feed the World
storyline:
Your story begins in a small woodland clearing, with a handful of seeds and a family to feed. Tend your first crops, raise animals and turn each harvest into meals. As your farm grows, welcome workers, build kitchens and bring a thriving village to life.

What starts as a home becomes a much larger ambition. Through changing seasons and increasingly complex production chains, grow from feeding a few people to feeding entire communities—with one extraordinary goal: produce one trillion meals and feed the world.
summary:
Start with a handful of seeds. Build a farm that feeds the world.

Feed the World is a single-player 3D farming and automation game where a small forest clearing grows into a thriving food empire.

Plant seasonal crops, raise livestock, hire workers and automate your fields and kitchens. Balance wages, power and profit as you turn each harvest into bigger possibilities—all towards one extraordinary goal: produce one trillion meals.
